# A/C Select

> Heating & air conditioning based in Temple, Texas. A/C Select repairs and installs heating and air in Temple and across Central Texas. Reviewers say Adam explains every option, never pushes what you don't need, and often has a tech out the same day.

## Services
- AC repair: Same-day and next-day repair visits around Temple, even in hundred-degree weather.
- AC replacement & new systems: Rheem systems installed with warranties on parts and work, wired and sealed neatly.
- Heating & heat pumps: Heater and heat pump repair, including the cold nights when a part has to be found fast.
- Twice-a-year maintenance: A plan with a spring and a fall tune-up, so small problems get caught before summer.
- Ductwork & central air: New duct runs, duct replacement and swapping out window units for central air.
- Commercial HVAC: Cooling for shops, churches and businesses, with exposed duct runs built to suit the space.

## About
A/C Select LLC is a small heating and air conditioning company based on W Ave O in Temple. It does full-service air conditioning and heating for homes and businesses across Central Texas, from a single repair call to a new Rheem system or ductwork for a shop. Owner Adam often comes out for the estimate and then does the install himself, with techs like Daniel and Steven on service calls. Some families have used Adam for many years, and local contractors recommend A/C Select to their own customers.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can someone come out the same day in Temple?
  A: Often, yes. Reviewers in Temple describe same-day and same-evening visits during summer heat. Call and you will get the earliest open slot.
- Q: Who does the estimate and the install?
  A: Usually Adam, the owner. Customers say the person who quoted the job was the same person who did the work.
- Q: What brand of equipment do you install?
  A: Rheem, with warranties on parts and work. A/C Select also honors manufacturer warranties on existing equipment.
- Q: Do you offer a maintenance plan?
  A: Yes. The plan covers two visits a year, one before cooling season and one before heating season.
- Q: Can you replace window units with central air?
  A: Yes. A/C Select has converted homes from window units to central air, with the ductwork installed as part of the job.
- Q: Do you work on businesses and churches?
  A: Yes. A/C Select handles commercial heating and air for shops, churches and other businesses in the Temple and Belton area.
